test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_kernel_futures_paper.py tests/test_kernel_futures_analytics.py tests/test_kernel_sdk_validation_futures_fx.py tests/test_kernel_portfolio.py tests/test_kernel_ledger_guards_ticks.py
test.result: 49 passed (exit code 0) across the futures paper account, futures analytics/contract validation, portfolio and ledger regression suites; Ruff and mypy on the new futures paper module passed.

implemented: A durable single-currency futures paper account accepts owner-supplied contract terms with source identifiers and SHA-256 provenance; no Indian exchange lot, tick, multiplier or margin constants are hardcoded.

Signed lot-sized trades, daily cash variation settlement, margin availability and maintenance-call status, expiry settlement, and atomic same-root later-expiry rolls are journaled and rebuilt through the existing hash-chained durable journal and double-entry ledger.

Event IDs are idempotent and bind to request content; insufficient initial margin, stale dates, incompatible roll lot sizes, invalid ticks, and conflicting retries are rejected without committing state.
Restart reproduces position, cash and variation P&L; focused futures and accounting regression suite passes.

Across successive settlement sessions, cash changes by signed position × multiplier × settlement-price change while open quantity stays unchanged; a second settlement and restart reproduce the same cash and position.
scope_note: Satisfies PE-0094: durable paper futures daily variation margin, compatible contract roll, and expiry settlement with cash/position reconciliation. It does not implement PE-0164 funding/open-interest analytics, external official contract-master validation, all futures trading costs, shared session-runner integration, or prospective profitability evidence; those are separate checklist tasks.
